# 需求1：网络可靠性

## X\_T2\_AGG1 交换机与X\_T1\_CORE1 以及接入交换机之间部署链路聚合

1、X\_T2\_AGG1、X\_T2\_ACC1、X\_T2\_ACC2上开启lldp，在X\_T2\_AGG1上查看互联接口

```apache
 lldp enable
 display lldp neighbor brief
```

2、在X\_T1\_Core1上创建聚合组

```apache
 interface Eth-Trunk2
   mode lacp
   trunkport g0/0/21
   trunkport g0/0/22
   trunkport g1/0/21
   trunkport g1/0/22
```

# 需求2：基础业务(VLAN、IP、DHCP、路由)

### 1、根据设备IP地址规划表，补全所有设备IP与VLAN

```apache
[X_T1_Core1]
  int g0/0/5   //Core1连接到FW
    port link-type trunk
    port trunk allow-pass vlan 206 207
    undo port trunk allow-pass vlan 1
  int vlan 206
    ip address 10.1.200.21 30
  int vlan 207
    ip address 10.1.200.25 30
```

### 2、配置业务网关

```apache
[X_T2_AGG1]
  interface Vlanif11
    ip address 10.1.11.254 255.255.255.0
  interface Vlanif12
    ip address 10.1.12.254 255.255.255.0
```

### 3、DHCP

 X\_T1\_Core1上在各个vlan接口开启DHCP全局查询服务（DHCP地址池已预配）

```apache
[X_T2_Core1]
   interface Vlanif51
      dhcp select global
   interface Vlanif101
      dhcp select global
```

 X\_T1\_AGG上在网关对应的vlan接口开启DHCP中继

```apache
[X_T1_AGG1]
   interface Vlanif11
      ip address 10.1.11.254 255.255.255.0
      dhcp select relay
      dhcp relay server-ip 10.1.200.29

```

X\_T2\_Core1上在与AGG互联的接口上也要开启DHCP全局功能

```apache
[X_T2_Core1]
   interface Vlanif208
      dhcp select global
```

# 需求3：网络隔离

### 1、X\_T1\_Core1部署vpn实例

```apache
ip vpn-instance Employee
   ipv4-family
     route-distinguisher 65001:1
ip vpn-instance Guest
   ipv4-family
     route-distinguisher 65001:2
```

### 2、相关网关vlan与互联vlan接口重新绑定vpn实例

```apache
interface Vlanif51
   ip binding vpn-instance Employee
   ip address 10.1.51.254 255.255.255.0
   dhcp select global
interface Vlanif101
   ip binding vpn-instance Guest
   ip address 10.1.101.254 255.255.255.0
   dhcp select global
interface Vlanif208   //连接T1-AGG
   ip binding vpn-instance Employee
   ip address 10.1.200.29 255.255.255.252
interface Vlanif209   //连接T2-AGG
   ip binding vpn-instance Employee
   ip address 10.1.200.33 255.255.255.252

```

### 3、DHCP地址池增加vpn实例

```apache
ip pool market1
   vpn-instance Employee
ip pool vlan101
   vpn-instance Guest
```

### 4、Employee实例的网络与外网互通

**i ) X\_T1\_Core1建立Employee实例的ospf**\
    vlan206对接实例Employ，vlan204对接全局；**（根据：VLANIF204 属于 untrust 安全域，VLANIF206 属于trust安全域）**

```apache
ospf 2 router-id 10.1.0.4 vpn-instance Employee //配置 Employee 实例用来实现和 Guest 网络的隔离
   silent-interface all
   undo silent-interface Vlanif206
   undo silent-interface Vlanif208
   undo silent-interface Vlanif209
   #实例Employee 中，除了 连接防火墙的vlanif206，还有下联 AGG 的 vlanif208 和 vlanif209，以及内网无线用户和服务器的网关。
   vpn-instance-capability simple //避免 OSPF 多实例不计算对应路由
   area 1
     network 10.1.0.0 0.0.255.255
```

**ii ) 防火墙建立Employee实例的ospf**\
    防火墙创建相关vlan，创建虚拟系统Employee

```apache
创建虚拟系统Employee
vsys name Employee
assign vlan 204
assign vlan 206

```

    进入Employee，将对应端口划分进入安全区域并配置IP地址

```apache
switch vsys Employee
firewall zone trust
   add interface vlanif 206
firewall zone untrust
   add interface vlanif 204
interface vlanif 204
   ip address 10.1.200.14 30
interface vlanif 206
   ip address 10.1.200.22 30

```

    配置防火墙OSPF邻居

```apache
ospf 2 router-id 10.1.0.8 vpn-instance Employee
   vpn-instance-capability simple
   area 1
     network 10.1.0.8 0.0.0.0
     network 10.1.200.14 0.0.0.0
     network 10.1.200.22 0.0.0.0

```

    在安全策略中放行OSPF，否则邻居建立会卡在ex-start阶段（DD报文无法通过）

```apache
[X_FW_Employee]和[X_FW_Guest]均需配置---虚墙，两个虚墙都要
security-policy
   rule name OSPF
   source-zone local
   source-zone trust
   source-zone untrust
   destination-zone local
   destination-zone trust
   destination-zone untrust
   service ospf
   action permit 

```

iii ) **X\_T1\_Core1建立全局ospf**

```apache
ospf 1 router-id 10.1.0.3
   area 0
     network 10.1.200.2 0.0.0.0
     network 10.1.200.6 0.0.0.0
     network 10.1.0.3 0.0.0.0
   area 1     //对接防火墙发来的 Employee 的流量
     network 10.1.200.13 0.0.0.0
   area 2    //对接防火墙发来的 Guest 的流量
     network 10.1.200.17 0.0.0.0
```

**iv ) X-T1-Export上建立ospf邻居，并且由于预配了nat，需要下发缺省路由**

```apache
ospf 1 router-id 10.1.0.1 
   default-route-advertise always
   area 0.0.0.0
      network 10.1.0.0 0.0.255.255 

```

**v ) 在X\_T1\_Core1上使用 IP-Prefix 作为过滤器进行路由过滤，禁止Guest路由进入Employee**    Emloyee的路由为区域1，Guest的路由为区域2，所有路由会首先进入骨干区域0，再分别作为三类路由分配进入各区域，所以在全局ospf进程的各个区域通过filter xxx import语句限制路由导入

```apache
ip ip-prefix denyguest deny 10.1.101.0 24
ip ip-prefix denyguest deny 10.1.102.0 24
ip ip-prefix denyguest deny 10.1.103.0 24
ip ip-prefix denyguest deny 10.1.104.0 24
ip ip-prefix denyguest deny 10.1.105.0 24
ip ip-prefix denyguest permit 0.0.0.0 0 less 32
ospf 1
   area 1
     filter ip-prefix denyguest import

```

# 需求4：WLAN扩容

### 1、在所有T2设备放行管理VLAN100

```apache
[X_T2_AGG1]
interface Eth-Trunk1
   port trunk allow-pass vlan 100
interface Eth-Trunk3
   port trunk allow-pass vlan  100
```

### 2、在AC上新建VLAN-POOL，并修改vap-profile中绑定的vlan

```apache
vlan pool Employee
   vlan 51 to 55
vlan pool Guest
   vlan 101 to 105
wlan
   vap-profile name Employee_001
      service-vlan vlan-pool Employee
   vap-profile name Guest_001
      service-vlan vlan-pool Guest

```

### 3、修改WLAN的安全模板

```apache
wlan
   security-profile name Employee_001
      security wpa2 psk pass-phrase Huawei@123 aes
```

### 4、添加AP

```apache
wlan
   ap-id 1 ap-mac 00e0-fca9-6ac0 
      ap-name AP2
      ap-group X_T1_AP

```

# 需求5：出口网络

### 1、配置默认路由与acl

```apache
acl 2000
   rule 5 permit
ip route-static 0.0.0.0 0 10.255.3.254
ip route-static 0.0.0.0 0 10.255.4.254

```

### 2、配置nat

```apache
interface g0/0/9
   ip address 10.255.3.1 24
   nat outbound 2000
   
nat address-group 1 10.255.4.2 10.255.4.100
interface g0/0/10
   ip address 10.255.4.1 24
   nat outbound 2000 address-group 1

```

### 3、配置指定IP访问web 服务

```
interface g0/0/10
   nat server protocol tcp global current-interface 8081 inside 10.1.60.101 www

```
